# ADR-0011 — Memory Is Hostile

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | Accepted |
| Origin | RFC-0002 Part 9 (SAD-0011) |

## Context

This decision was ratified as a Security Architecture Decision (SAD) in the threat model and is binding across the platform.

## Decision

RAM SHALL be treated as compromised; plaintext lifetime SHALL be minimized and buffers zeroized.

## Consequences

Changing this decision requires a superseding RFC per [RFC-0029 Architecture Governance](../rfcs/RFC-0029/README.md).
